title: Configurable port and DB path via env vars
evidence: main.go:30-47 reads DATABASE_PATH and PORT with sensible defaults

title: JSON decoder does not reject unknown/extra fields
evidence: main.go:206-213 decodeJSON uses json.NewDecoder without DisallowUnknownFields; malformed extra fields are silently ignored
suggestion: Optionally call decoder.DisallowUnknownFields() for stricter input validation

title: PUT full-replace semantics untested for partial updates
evidence: main.go:145 UPDATE overwrites all columns; a PUT omitting year/isbn zeroes them, and no test covers this behavior
suggestion: Add a test documenting full-replace semantics or switch to PATCH-style partial updates
